_note: Playable quiz rules (Divit 2026-10-14, day step 5; docs/QUIZ.md). Read by qc/quiz.py (QC Z codes) and the page pack. Quiz pages = SurveyQuiz hub, slug contains 'quiz'.

lengths._note: characters, measured for one-question-per-screen at 390 px (question <= 3 lines at 19 px, option <= 2 lines at 16 px)

diagnosis._note: P0 (Z5): a quiz never diagnoses. Results are preferences or knowledge bands, never a medical, psychological or clinical condition. A disclaimer ('this is not a diagnosis') is allowed.
diagnosis.conditions: adhd|add|autism|autistic|asperger'?s?|depression|depressed|anxiety disorder|anxiety|ocd|obsessive[- ]compulsive|bipolar|ptsd|trauma|dyslexia|dyslexic|dementia|alzheimer'?s?|eating disorder|anorexi[ac]|bulimi[ac]|insomnia|schizophreni[ac]|psychosis|psychotic|narcissis(?:m|tic)|a narcissist|psychopath(?:ic)?|a psychopath|sociopath(?:ic)?|a sociopath|borderline|personality disorder|disorder|syndrome|codependen(?:t|cy)|neurodivergent|on the spectrum|mentally ill|mental illness|suicidal|addict(?:ed|ion)?|diabetes|diabetic|cancer|disease|illness|allergy|allergic|deficiency|intolerance|infertil(?:e|ity)
patterns: \byou\s+(?:(?:probably|likely|may|might|could|clearly|definitely)\s+)?(?:have|suffer from|show (?:signs|symptoms) of|have (?:signs|symptoms) of|are suffering from|live with|struggle with)\s+(?:(?:an?|the|some|mild|severe|high-functioning)\s+)?(?:{C})\b

franchises._note: Z8 (P1): no trademarked characters or franchises as results unless the page's primary keyword names the franchise (fair use is the reviewer's call).

fact_rx: \b\d|\b(?:percent|according to|research|studies|study|scientists?|experts?|proven|found that|data shows?|on average|the (?:largest|smallest|oldest|newest|first|only|highest|lowest|longest|shortest|most|least|deepest|tallest|fastest)|capital of|was (?:founded|invented|discovered|written|signed|built|born)|is (?:called|known as|defined as|named)|means)\b

type_hints._note: skeleton.py build suggests the quiz type from the primary keyword; the writer may choose the other type when the page's promise needs it
